column1: # ── False positives / acceptable for SaaS API ───────────────────────────────
# Absence of Anti-CSRF tokens — API uses JWT Bearer, no forms
# X-Content-Type-Options not set — set by Azure CDN/Front Door at the edge
# Cookie without SameSite — handled by Azure App Service auth cookies
# Cache-Control for HTTPS — static assets are intentionally cached
# User Controllable HTML element attribute — false positive in React SPA
# Content Security Policy header not set — in progress
# Strict-Transport-Security header not set — set at Front Door level
# X-Frame-Options not set — mitigated by CSP frame-ancestors
